entries.title: Native dependency cannot find the libarchive header
entries.root_cause: The runner lacks the libarchive development headers required to compile the archive_bridge dependency's C extension. Install the libarchive development package on the runner.

entries.title: Dispatch window boundary test fails
entries.root_cause: The dispatch window includes its exclusive closing boundary, causing the boundary test to fail. Correct the closing-boundary comparison in the application.
